dataStorage.description: Tendril keeps your config and plans in this folder.

repoPicker.label: Add one or more Git repositories
repoPicker.willClone: will be cloned on Create Project

firstProject.title: Setup your first project
firstProject.description: A project groups one or more repositories together so Tendril can plan and verify changes across them.
firstProject.browseUnavailable: Folder picker unavailable ({{error}}). Type a path instead.

nameExists.title: A project with this name already exists.
nameExists.body: To resolve this conflict, you can either enter a different name above, or proceed using the existing project's configuration (its repository path and settings will be preserved).

firstProject.registered: {{name}} is registered. Next shows its setup run.

validation.invalidProjectName: Invalid project name '{{name}}'. Use only letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores (no slashes or spaces).
validation.invalidProjectNameWithSuggestion: Invalid project name '{{name}}'. Use only letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores (no slashes or spaces). Suggested: '{{suggestion}}'.

agentRun.title: Setting up your project
agentRun.wizardHint: Tendril is detecting your tech stack and configuring your agentic harness. This will take a few minutes, so treat yourself to a ☕ while you wait.
agentRun.noRun: No setup run is attached to this project. You can configure its verifications and review actions from the project's own screen once setup is finished.

harness.title: Review Harness
harness.description: What the setup agent configured for your project. Everything here is editable from the project's own screen.

verifications.title: Verifications
verifications.hint: The steps run after each plan execution to validate changes.

reviewActions.title: Review Actions
reviewActions.hint: Commands that make it easy to start your project for manual testing.

harness.loadError: Could not read your project's harness ({{error}}). This says nothing about what the setup agent configured - open the project from the Projects row to see it.
harness.empty: Nothing is configured yet. If the setup agent is still running, its results appear here once it finishes - reopen the project from the Projects row to see them.

complete.title: Ready to Go!
complete.description: Your project is configured. Click Finish to start using Tendril.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Be the first to know when we have a new release!

addProject.title: Add a Project
addProject.hint: Name the project and point it at one or more Git repositories. Tendril then inspects them and configures the review harness.
addProject.nameInvalidChars: A project name cannot contain / \ : * ? " < > or |.

addProject.agentHint: Tendril is detecting your tech stack and configuring your agentic harness. This takes a few minutes.
addProject.noVerifications: No verifications were configured. Add them from the project's settings.
addProject.noReviewActions: No review actions were configured. Add them from the project's settings.
